subject: mathematics
question_text: Find a unit vector perpendicular to the plane containing the vectors a = 4i + 3j − k and b = 2i − 6j − 3k.

verification.note: Source: Baby Bullet-Q, Junior Inter Maths-1A (Sri Publishers, Machilipatnam), book p.91 — VSAQ chapter 17 Product of Vectors, answer 122.1. recall_prompt: Say how you would find a unit vector perpendicular to two given vectors.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Find a×b
steps.margin_note: First mark. The cross product of two vectors is perpendicular to both, so it is already the direction wanted — only its length needs fixing. Take 5 out.

recall.must_convey: That a×b is computed as the perpendicular direction, giving 5(−3i + 2j − 6k) with magnitude 35.
accept: cross a and b to get the perpendicular direction, five into minus three i plus two j minus six k, magnitude thirty five
the cross product is perpendicular to both and its magnitude is thirty five
take a cross b and its modulus
a cross b perpendicular vasthundi, magnitude thirty five
compute the cross product and its length

steps.why: Any vector perpendicular to both a and b is perpendicular to the plane they span. The cross product supplies one directly.
common_mistakes: Taking a dot product, which gives no direction.
Squaring 15, 10 and 30 instead of factoring the 5 out first.

steps.label: Divide by the magnitude
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The 5 cancels into the 35, leaving 7 in the denominator. Keep the ± — there are two unit normals, one each way.

recall.must_convey: That dividing by the magnitude gives ±(3i − 2j + 6k)/7, and that the ± must be kept.
accept: divide by thirty five so the five cancels leaving plus or minus three i minus two j plus six k over seven
the unit vector is plus or minus three i minus two j plus six k all over seven
keep the plus minus because there are two normals
thirty five tho divide cheste seven vasthundi, plus or minus tho
the answer is plus minus three i minus two j plus six k by seven

steps.why: Reversing a perpendicular leaves it perpendicular, so both signs are correct answers. Dropping the ± reports only one of them.
common_mistakes: Failing to cancel the 5 into the 35.
